fix: CardTile memory leak in pooled AnimatedCards

CardTile subscribes to four static publishers (CardsChanged,
InitialDefsLoaded, ThemeChanged, CardLanguageChanged) on WPF Loaded
and unsubscribes on Unloaded. For pooled controls, these events do not
always fire in pairs: reparenting can trigger Loaded without a prior
Unloaded, and the pool overflow path calls Dispose() without ever
triggering Unloaded. Each missed Unloaded leaves the CardTile pinned
to the static delegates, keeping the whole AnimatedCard alive.

We fix this by replacing Loaded/Unloaded with explicit Subscribe/
Unsubscribe calls tied to the pool lifecycle (ctor, OnReuseFromPool,
Cleanup), the same pattern used for PinsChanged.

fix: serve cached assets from disk when the LRU index misses

Portrait/tile assets fell back to the Faceless placeholder whenever their
cache-index entry was missing (evicted index, a delete that failed while the
image was in use, or an eviction race between a completed download and its
use). GetAssetEntry could also return null silently after a successful
download, leaving the placeholder up with no retry and nothing logged.

We now adopt on-disk files on an index miss, recover (and log) instead of
silently returning null, keep in-flight downloads from being evicted, and let
CardAssetViewModel keep retrying rather than sticking on the placeholder.
